dreamteamer.title: Web
dreamteamer.description: dt web: the dreamteamer UI in a browser over a workspace on your own machine — the extension's nav, lists, boards and record pages, served on loopback behind a single-use sign-in, with record files on a second sandboxed origin and live updates as records change on disk. Adds the dt web verb and a web row in dt doctor.
